cards.old_note: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.* The Hebrew library's explicit naming of the Son of Adam before creation — the framework's *son of Adam* restoration grounded in the extras-tier witness. The Yahusha (Jesus) named in Matt 1:21 IS the Son of Adam named at 1 Enoch 48:2.
cards.new_note: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.* (1 Enoch 48:2). *And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name Yahusha (JESUS): for he shall save his people from their sins* (Matthew 1:21). The name given at the manger had already been named before the Head of Days. Enoch saw the Son of Adam named in the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits before there was a Bethlehem to be born in; the angel's instruction to Yoseph (Joseph) is that name arriving on earth. The one who saves his people is the one who was named before his people existed.
cards.live_text: And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.

cards.old_note: *And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.* The Formed chosen and hidden before creation; the Immanuel of Matt 1:23 is the same Formed now revealed in flesh. The framework's Formless-and-Formed nature-of-God reading carries from 1 Enoch through Matthew without contradiction.
cards.new_note: *And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.* (1 Enoch 48:6). *They shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, Elohim (God) with us* (Matthew 1:23). Chosen and hidden before the creation of the world — then revealed in flesh. The Formed one, drawn from the Father before anything was made, is the one Matthew calls *Elohim (God) with us.* He was not new at the manger; he was hidden, and the hiding ended.
cards.live_text: And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.

cards.old_note: *And there I saw One who had a head of days, and His head was white like wool, and with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, and his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels.* 1 Enoch 46:1 names the throne-room vision in the Hebrew library's apocalyptic register — the Head of Days and another being with the appearance of a man beside Him. This is the opening of the named-title Messianic-figure passage (1 Enoch 46:1-3) the framework reads as the load-bearing Hebrew-library parallel for Matt 8:20's *the Son of Adam.* The figure is named as the Christ in heavenly vision before the incarnation.
cards.new_note: *And there I saw One who had a head of days, And His head was white like wool, And with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, And his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels.* (1 Enoch 46:1). *The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of Adam hath not where to lay his head* (Matthew 8:20). This is where the title comes from. Enoch saw the Head of Days, white-haired, and beside him one with the face of a man and the graciousness of a holy angel, and asked who he was. When Yahusha (Jesus) calls himself the Son of Adam, he is naming himself as the one who stood beside the Head of Days — and that one now has no bed on the earth he came to.
cards.live_text: And there I saw One who had a head of days, And His head was white like wool, And with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, And his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels.

cards.old_note: *And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness, and who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him, and whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (God) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* 1 Enoch 46:3 locks the identification of the figure: *the Son of Adam who hath righteousness ... whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (God) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* This is the Christ — chosen, pre-eminent, the revealer of hidden treasures. The Hebrew library's named-title parallel for Matt 8:20's self-designation is locked in this verse. The figure Enoch saw in heavenly vision is the figure Yahusha (Jesus) names himself as in the gospel.
cards.new_note: *And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* (1 Enoch 46:3). *The Son of Adam hath not where to lay his head* (Matthew 8:20). The angel answered Enoch's question by title and by role: the Son of Adam who has righteousness, who reveals what is hidden, whom Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits has chosen, whose lot has the pre-eminence for ever. That is the figure Yahusha (Jesus) names himself as. The pre-eminent one before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits is the homeless one on the road to Capernaum, and both are the same Son of Adam.
cards.live_text: And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.

cards.old_note: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.* 1 Enoch 48:2 names the Son of Adam's pre-existence-and-naming-before-the-Head-of-Days architecture in the Similitudes — the Son of Adam was named BEFORE creation; his name was named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Matt 9:6's *the Son of Adam hath power on earth to forgive sins* is the in-flesh exercise of the authority that 1 Enoch 48 names as eternally-pre-existent. The figure who has the Father's-forgiveness-prerogative in flesh is the figure 1 Enoch had named as pre-existent. Red Line #12 governs the named-title rendering (not kaph-comparative).
cards.new_note: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.* (1 Enoch 48:2). *The Son of Adam hath power on earth to forgive sins* (Matthew 9:6). The scribes called it blasphemy because only Yahuah (God) forgives. Enoch had already seen this Son of Adam named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, before the Head of Days — named, not made. The power exercised over a palsied man in Capernaum is the standing of the one who was named before creation, now exercised in flesh. The scribes were right about who forgives; they were wrong about who stood in front of them.
cards.live_text: And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.

cards.old_note: *And in those days the destitute shall go forth and carry off their children, And they shall abandon them, so that their children shall perish through them: Yea, they shall abandon their children.* 1 Enoch 99:5 names the wisdom-stream's apocalyptic-register naming of the day-of-destruction family-disintegration: parents abandoning children, children perishing through parents. Matt 10:35-36's *I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother* walks the same household-division-pattern at the kingdom-citizens-hearing-the-Shepherd-divides-the-household register. The wisdom-stream had named the disintegration-of-the-household as the day-of-destruction signature; the King names the kingdom-hearing-of-his-voice as producing the division-line that runs through the household.
cards.new_note: *And in those days the destitute shall go forth and carry off their children, And they shall abandon them, so that their children shall perish through them: Yea, they shall abandon their children (that are still) sucklings, and not return to them, And shall have no pity on their beloved ones.* (1 Enoch 99:5). *I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother* (Matthew 10:35). Enoch saw the household come apart in the day of destruction — parents carrying off and abandoning their own children, no pity for their beloved. The King says the same division will run through the household when his voice is heard, because some in the house will hear and some will not. The line does not stop at the front door.
cards.live_text: And in those days the destitute shall go forth and carry off their children, And they shall abandon them, so that their children shall perish through them: Yea, they shall abandon their children (that are still) sucklings, and not return to them, And shall have no pity on their beloved ones.

cards.old_note: *And in those days in one place the fathers together with their sons shall be smitten, And brothers one with another shall fall in death Till the streams flow with their blood.* 1 Enoch 100:1-2 names the wisdom-stream's apocalyptic-register naming of the family-betrayal-in-the-day-of-destruction architecture: fathers and sons smitten together, brothers falling on brothers. Matt 10:36's *a man's foes shall be they of his own household* (citing Micah 7:6) walks the same architecture. The framework reads the seed-war (Genesis 3:15) as operative at the household-level — the kingdom-citizens' hearing of the Shepherd's voice creates a division-line the family-relationship cannot insulate from. The wisdom-stream had named the diagnostic at the apocalyptic-register; the King names it at the commissioning-discourse register.
cards.new_note: *And in those days in one place the fathers together with their sons shall be smitten And brothers one with another shall fall in death Till the streams flow with their blood. For a man shall not withhold his hand from slaying his sons and his sons’ sons, And the sinner shall not withhold his hand from his honoured brother: From dawn till sunset they shall slay one another.* (1 Enoch 100:1–2). *And a man's foes shall be they of his own household* (Matthew 10:36). The King is quoting Micah: *a man's enemies are the men of his own house* (Micah 7:6). Enoch saw it in blood — fathers and sons smitten in one place, brother falling on brother from dawn till sunset. The seed war of Genesis 3:15 runs inside families, not only between nations; two brunettes can bear a son of Belial, and Eli's own sons were sons of Belial. Hearing the Shepherd's voice divides a house because not everyone in the house is a sheep.
cards.live_text: And in those days in one place the fathers together with their sons shall be smitten And brothers one with another shall fall in death Till the streams flow with their blood.

cards.old_note: *And there I saw One who had a head of days, and His head was white like wool, and with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, and his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels.* 1 Enoch 46:1 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Father-Son architecture at the apocalyptic-register: the One-who-had-a-head-of-days (the Father) and the Son-of-Adam-whose-countenance-had-the-appearance-of-a-man-and-whose-face-was-full-of-graciousness (the Son). Matt 11:25-27's Father-Son revelation-economy prayer walks the same architecture at the kingdom-discourse register: the Father (*Lord of heaven and earth*) and the Son (*all things are delivered unto me of my Father; and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son*). The wisdom-stream had named the architecture; the King at Matt 11:25-27 names it operative in his own voice.
cards.new_note: *And there I saw One who had a head of days, And His head was white like wool, And with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, And his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels.* (1 Enoch 46:1). *No man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son* (Matthew 11:27). Enoch saw the two together before the incarnation: One with a head of days, and with him another whose face was like a man's and full of grace. The Father and the Son, side by side, in a vision written centuries before Matthew. What the King says in prayer — that the Father and the Son know each other as no one else does — Enoch saw as a picture: the two of them, together, and no third.
cards.live_text: And there I saw One who had a head of days, And His head was white like wool, And with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, And his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels.

cards.old_note: *This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness, and who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him.* 1 Enoch 46:3 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Son-of-Adam-revealing-the-hidden-treasures architecture: the Son-of-Adam reveals the hidden-treasures because Yahuah (God) has chosen him. Matt 11:27's *no man knoweth the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him* walks the same revelation-economy architecture explicitly. The framework reads 1 Enoch 46:3 as the wisdom-stream's named anchor of the *son of Adam* lineage-weight (Red Line #12) restored — the title-naming case where the kaph-comparative is NOT operative; the figure is named the Son of Adam outright. The Matt 11:27 *only the Son reveals the Father* and the 1 Enoch 46:3 *the Son-of-Adam revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden* name the same operative-fact: revelation-of-the-Father is mediated through the Son.
cards.new_note: *And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* (1 Enoch 46:3). *Neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him* (Matthew 11:27). The angel told Enoch what the Son of Adam does: he *revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden,* because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits chose him. The Father is the hidden treasure; the Son is the one who reveals him, and he reveals him to whom he will. Enoch is told this by title; the King says it in the first person.
cards.live_text: And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.

cards.old_note: *And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.* 1 Enoch 48:6 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Son-chosen-and-hidden-before-the-creation-of-the-world architecture. The framework reads the verse as the wisdom-stream anchor of the Red Line #11 *names-written-before-the-foundation-of-the-world* architecture extended to the Son himself — the Son named before the creation, hidden before the Father, revealed-to-the-elect at the appointed-time. Matt 11:27's *no man knoweth the Son, but the Father* names the unique-mutual-knowledge between the chosen-and-hidden-Son and the Father — the relational-substance the wisdom-stream had named at the apocalyptic-register restated by the King at the kingdom-discourse register.
cards.new_note: *And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.* (1 Enoch 48:6). *No man knoweth the Son, but the Father* (Matthew 11:27). Chosen and hidden before him, before the creation of the world — the Son was known to the Father before anyone else existed to know him. That is why no one knows the Son but the Father: the knowing began before the world did. The disciples would come to know him later; the Father's knowing has no beginning.
cards.live_text: And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.

cards.old_note: *And the wisdom of Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness.* 1 Enoch 48:7 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the revelation-economy: the wisdom-of-Yahuah (God) reveals the Son-of-Adam to the holy-and-righteous — the body that has hated-and-despised-this-world-of-unrighteousness. The framework reads the verse against Matt 11:25's *thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes* — the revelation-economy at the King's prayer names the same architecture: revelation is to the un-credentialed-receptive (the babes, the holy-and-righteous-who-have-despised-this-world); concealment is from the system-credentialed (the wise-and-prudent, the world-of-unrighteousness). The Father's sovereign-revelation-choice aligns with the substance Red Line #11's seed-war-hearing-pattern names.
cards.new_note: *And the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness, And have hated all its works and ways in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: For in his name they are saved, And according to his good pleasure hath it been in regard to their life.* (1 Enoch 48:7). *Thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes* (Matthew 11:25). Enoch says who the revealing is for: the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits reveals him *to the holy and righteous,* the ones who have hated this world of unrighteousness and all its ways. Not the credentialed, not the wise in their own eyes — the ones whose lot he preserved. The babes of Matthew 11:25 are the holy and righteous of 1 Enoch 48:7. The revealing does not make them his; it finds them already his.
cards.live_text: And the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness, And have hated all its works and ways in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: For in his name they are saved, And according to his good pleasure hath it been in regard to their life.

cards.old_note: *For wisdom is poured out like water, And glory faileth not before him for evermore. For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness, And unrighteousness shall disappear as a shadow.* 1 Enoch 49:1 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the wisdom-poured-out-on-the-Elect-One architecture. Matt 12:18's *I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the goyim* (citing Isaiah 42:1) walks the same architecture at the gospel-restatement register: the Father's-Spirit-anointing of the Son the King walks publicly through the Galilean-ministry. The framework reads the verse-pair as one architecture across two registers: the wisdom-stream knew the Elect-One's wisdom-anointing-from-the-Father; Matt 12:18 names the operative-fact at the inaugurated-ministry.
cards.new_note: *For wisdom is poured out like water, And glory faileth not before him for evermore. For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness, And unrighteousness shall disappear as a shadow, And have no continuance; Because the Elect One standeth before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his glory is for ever and ever, And his might unto all generations.* (1 Enoch 49:1–2). *Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him* (Matthew 12:18). Matthew is quoting Isaiah 42:1 over the Galilean ministry. Enoch saw the same anointing from the other side of the veil: wisdom poured out on the Elect One like water, glory that does not fail, might in all the secrets of righteousness. The Spirit the Father put upon his servant at the river is the wisdom Enoch saw poured out on the one who stands before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
cards.live_text: For wisdom is poured out like water, And glory faileth not before him for evermore.

cards.old_note: *And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might, And the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.* 1 Enoch 49:3 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the four-spirits-on-the-Elect-One architecture — the same four-spirits-cluster Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 11:2 names of the Branch-from-Yishai (Jesse): the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahuah (the LORD). The framework reads 1 Enoch 49:3 as the wisdom-stream restatement of Isaiah 11:2 applied to the Elect-One — the same Spirit-anointing substance Matt 12:18 names in Yahusha (Jesus) at the immersion (Matt 3:16-17). The Tanakh anchor, the wisdom-stream anchor, and the gospel-fulfillment name one Spirit-anointing-architecture across three registers.
cards.new_note: *And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might, And the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.* (1 Enoch 49:3). *I will put my spirit upon him* (Matthew 12:18). Isaiah named what that Spirit is: *the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahuah (LORD)* (Isaiah 11:2). Enoch names the same spirits dwelling in the Elect One — wisdom, insight, understanding and might — and adds one Isaiah did not: *the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.* The anointed one carries the righteous dead with him. Three witnesses, one Spirit, one anointed.
cards.live_text: And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might, And the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.

cards.old_note: *And again Yahuah (the Lord) said to Raphael: Bind Azazel hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dudael, and cast him therein. And place upon him rough and jagged rocks, and cover him with darkness, and let him abide there for ever.* 1 Enoch 10:4-5 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the binding-of-the-watchers-leader-Azazel architecture: bound-hand-and-foot, cast-into-the-darkness, sealed-with-rocks, covered-with-darkness for the appointed-time. The framework reads the verse against Matt 12:29's *how can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.* The King's exorcisms-and-spoiling are the inaugurated-form of the binding-architecture the wisdom-stream had named at the watcher-leader register; the full-binding-of-Satan at Revelation 20:1-3 lands the architecture at the millennial-consummation. The wisdom-stream knew the binding-and-darkness-and-appointed-time pattern; the King at Matt 12:29 walks the inaugurated-binding-and-spoiling.
cards.new_note: *And again Yahuah (Lord) said to Raphael: ‘Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dûdâêl, and cast him therein. And place upon him rough and jagged rocks, and cover him with darkness, and let him abide there for ever, and cover his face that he may not see light.* (1 Enoch 10:4–5). *How can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man?* (Matthew 12:29). Binding is how Yahuah (God) deals with the strong man. Raphael was sent to bind Azazel hand and foot, cast him into darkness, cover him with rocks, and leave him there until the judgment. When Yahusha (Jesus) cast out devils and said the strong man had to be bound first, he was describing something that had been done before and would be done again — the binding of the serpent for the length of the reign (Revelation 20:2). The exorcisms were the spoiling; the binding is older than Galilee.
cards.live_text: And again Yahuah (Lord) said to Raphael: ‘Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dûdâêl, and cast him therein.

cards.old_note: *And I asked the angel of peace who went with me, saying: For whom are these chains being prepared? And he said unto me: These are being prepared for the hosts of Azazel, so that they may take them and cast them into the abyss of complete condemnation, and they shall cover their jaws with rough stones as Yahuah (the Lord) of Spirits commanded.* 1 Enoch 54:5 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the chains-prepared-for-Azazel-and-his-hosts and the casting-into-the-abyss-of-complete-condemnation architecture. The framework reads the verse against Matt 12:29's binding-the-strong-man: the wisdom-stream knew the chains-prepared and the abyss-of-condemnation as the eschatological-architecture awaiting Azazel and his hosts; the King at Matt 12:29 walks the inaugurated-action that culminates in the architecture the wisdom-stream had named.
cards.new_note: *And he said unto me: ‘These are being prepared for the hosts of Azâzêl, so that they may take them and cast them into the abyss of complete condemnation, and they shall cover their jaws with rough stones as Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits commanded.* (1 Enoch 54:5). *Except he first bind the strong man* (Matthew 12:29). Enoch asked what the chains were for and was told: for the hosts of Azazel, to cast them into the abyss of complete condemnation with their jaws covered in stones. The chains were already forged when the King spoke of binding. The spoiling of the strong man's house in Galilee is the beginning of what those chains were made for.
cards.live_text: And he said unto me: ‘These are being prepared for the hosts of Azâzêl, so that they may take them and cast them into the abyss of complete condemnation, and they shall cover their jaws with rough stones as Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits commanded.

cards.old_note: *And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.* 1 Enoch 51:1 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the earth-and-Sheol-and-hell-giving-back-what-they-have-received architecture: resurrection-from-the-place-of-the-dead at the appointed-time. The framework reads the verse against Matt 12:40's sign-of-Yonah three-days-and-three-nights-in-the-heart-of-the-earth: the wisdom-stream knew the earth-and-Sheol-giving-back-the-dead architecture; the King at Matt 12:40 names the inaugurated-form of the architecture in his own future-resurrection that the Yonah-typology pre-announces. The Yonah-vomited-out-by-the-fish at Yonah (Jonah) 2:10 is the typological-anchor the King draws; the wisdom-stream architecture of Sheol-giving-back is the framework-context.
cards.new_note: *And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.* (1 Enoch 51:1). *So shall the Son of Adam be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth* (Matthew 12:40). The heart of the earth gives back. Enoch saw the earth return what was entrusted to it, Sheol give back what it received, hell give back what it owes. The sign of Jonah is a man going into the deep and being given back; the Son of Adam went into the heart of the earth knowing the earth would have to return him, because the earth returns what it holds.
cards.live_text: And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.

cards.old_note: *And it came to pass when the children of men had multiplied that in those days were born unto them beautiful and comely daughters. And the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: "Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men and beget us children."* 1 Enoch 6:1-2 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the watchers' incursion: the children-of-the-heaven saw-and-lusted-after the daughters-of-men and took-wives-from-among-them. The framework reads the verse as THE foundational-anchor for the tares-sown-by-the-enemy at Matt 13:25. The watchers' incursion produced the corrupted-line-of-the-giants and the spirits-of-the-giants that operate within-the-field-of-the-world as the seed-of-the-wicked-one. The King at Matt 13:25 names the operative-parable-form of the architecture the wisdom-stream had named at the chronological-source register: the enemy-sowing-tares-while-men-slept is the wisdom-stream's watchers-coming-while-men-slept-in-Yared (Jared)'s-days.
cards.new_note: *And it came to pass when the children of men had multiplied that in those days were born unto them beautiful and comely daughters. And the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: ‘Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men and beget us children.’* (1 Enoch 6:1–2). *But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat* (Matthew 13:25). Here is the sowing. In the days of Jared the children of heaven looked on the daughters of men and took wives, and a seed entered the field that was not of Adam. The enemy sowed while men slept; Enoch tells you who the enemy was and what he sowed. The parable is not a figure of speech. It is the history of Genesis 6 told as a field.
cards.live_text: And it came to pass when the children of men had multiplied that in those days were born unto them beautiful and comely daughters.

cards.old_note: *And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling. Evil spirits have proceeded from their bodies; because they are born from men and from the holy Watchers is their beginning and primal origin; they shall be evil spirits on earth, and evil spirits shall they be called.* 1 Enoch 15:8-9 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the spirits-of-the-giants-as-evil-spirits-upon-the-earth architecture: the giants died-physically but the spirits-of-the-giants continue-on-the-earth as evil-spirits. The framework reads the verse against Matt 13:38-39's *the tares are the children of the wicked one ... the enemy that sowed them is the devil.* The wisdom-stream had named the architecture of the spirits-of-the-corruption operating-on-the-earth after the original-watchers' incursion; the King's parable names the operative-form of the seed-distinction at the field-of-the-world register. The evil-spirits-of-the-giants are the operative-instruments of the wicked-one's-sowing across the age.
cards.new_note: *And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling. Evil spirits have proceeded from their bodies; because they are born from men and from the holy Watchers is their beginning and primal origin; they shall be evil spirits on earth, and evil spirits shall they be called.* (1 Enoch 15:8–9). *The tares are the children of the wicked one* (Matthew 13:38). The children of the wicked one have a father and a beginning. Enoch names it: the giants born of spirits and flesh became evil spirits on the earth when their bodies died, and evil spirits they are called. The tares are not bad wheat; they are another seed with another origin, and the spirits of that seed are still at work in the field. The parable names them; 1 Enoch names where they came from.
cards.live_text: And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling.

cards.old_note: *Be hopeful; for aforetime ye were put to shame through ill and affliction; but now ye shall shine as the lights of heaven, ye shall shine and ye shall be seen, and the portals of heaven shall be opened to you.* 1 Enoch 104:2 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for Matt 13:43's *then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father* substance: the righteous shall-shine-as-the-lights-of-heaven at the eschatological-vindication. The framework reads the verse against Matt 13:43: the wisdom-stream knew the architecture of the righteous-shining-as-the-lights-of-heaven at the day-of-vindication; the King names the operative-form at the wheat-and-tares-interpretation register. The shall-be-seen-and-the-portals-of-heaven-shall-be-opened substance carries the kingdom-of-the-Father vindication-architecture the King names at Matt 13:43. Two wisdom-stream witnesses (1 Enoch 104:2 here and Daniel 12:3 at the Tanakh-register) establish the substance the King's parable interpretation names at the gospel-register.
cards.new_note: *Be hopeful; for aforetime ye were put to shame through ill and affliction; but now ye shall shine as the lights of heaven, ye shall shine and ye shall be seen, and the portals of heaven shall be opened to you.* (1 Enoch 104:2). *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father* (Matthew 13:43). Enoch says it to the righteous directly: you were put to shame, and now you shall shine as the lights of heaven, you shall be seen, and the portals of heaven shall be opened to you. Daniel says the same (Daniel 12:3). The shining is not a reward for effort; it is what happens to the righteous when the shame is lifted at the harvest.
cards.live_text: Be hopeful; for aforetime ye were put to shame through ill and affliction; but now ye shall shine as the lights of heaven, ye shall shine and ye shall be seen, and the portals of heaven shall be opened to you.

cards.old_note: *And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before him, before the creation of the world and for evermore.* 1 Enoch 48:6 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for Matt 13:35's *I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world* substance: the Elect-One was-chosen-and-hidden-before-the-creation-of-the-world-and-for-evermore. The framework reads the verse against Matt 13:34-35: the wisdom-stream knew the architecture of the Elect-One hidden-from-the-foundation-of-the-world and revealed-at-the-appointed-time; the King at Matt 13:35 fulfills the Psalm 78:2 substance by uttering things-which-have-been-kept-secret-from-the-foundation-of-the-world. The wisdom-stream and the King's-own-self-disclosure name one architecture: the substance hidden from the foundation is the substance the parables-method now reveals to the disciples.
cards.new_note: *And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.* (1 Enoch 48:6). *I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world* (Matthew 13:35). The one speaking in parables was himself the secret kept from the foundation of the world — chosen and hidden before the creation, and for evermore. When he opens his mouth in parables he is the hidden one revealing hidden things. The secret and the one who tells it are the same.
cards.live_text: And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.

cards.old_note: *And over all the righteous and holy he will appoint guardians from amongst the holy angels to guard them as the apple of an eye, until he makes an end of all wickedness and all sin, and though the righteous sleep a long sleep, they have nought to fear.* 1 Enoch 100:5 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the holy-angels-guarding-the-righteous architecture at the eschatological-judgment register: the angels are-appointed-to-guard-the-righteous as-the-apple-of-an-eye until-the-end-of-all-wickedness-and-all-sin. The framework reads the verse against Matt 13:49: the angels-as-guards-and-as-severers operate in the same architecture across the wisdom-stream and the gospel. The Son-of-Adam-sends-the-angels for both the gathering-of-the-righteous AND the severing-of-the-wicked; the wisdom-stream knew the angelic-architecture; the King names the operative-form.
cards.new_note: *And over all the righteous and holy He will appoint guardians from amongst the holy angels To guard them as the apple of an eye, Until He makes an end of all wickedness and all sin, And though the righteous sleep a long sleep, they have nought to fear.* (1 Enoch 100:5). *The angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just* (Matthew 13:49). The angels who sever at the end are the angels who guard until the end. Enoch saw holy angels set over the righteous as guardians, keeping them as the apple of an eye until all wickedness is done away, so that the righteous sleep without fear. The same hands that guard the just through the age are the hands that separate the wicked from them at the harvest.
cards.live_text: And over all the righteous and holy He will appoint guardians from amongst the holy angels To guard them as the apple of an eye, Until He makes an end of all wickedness and all sin, And though the righteous sleep a long sleep, they have nought to fear.

cards.old_note: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named in the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, and his name before the Head of Days.* 1 Enoch 48:2 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the Son-of-Adam-being-named-in-the-presence-of-Yahuah-of-Spirits substance — the heavenly-naming-of-the-Christ at the throne. The framework reads the verse against Matt 16:16's *thou art the Messiah, the Son of the living Elohim (God).* Kefa's (Peter's)-confession articulates at the earthly-gospel-pivot what 1 Enoch 48:2 names at the heavenly-throne-pivot: the Son-of-Adam's name is the name-named-before-the-Head-of-Days. The wisdom-stream had named the heavenly-substance; the gospel-confession lands the earthly-confession of the same architecture; the cause-and-effect-of-hearing per Red Line #11 operates at the Father's-revealing the same substance the wisdom-stream carried.
cards.new_note: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.* (1 Enoch 48:2). *Thou art the Messiah (Christ), the Son of the living Elohim (God)* (Matthew 16:16). Kefa (Peter) names him on earth. Enoch saw him named in heaven — the Son of Adam named in the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, before the Head of Days. The confession at Caesarea Philippi did not give him the name; it recognized a name that was given before the world was made.
cards.live_text: And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.

cards.old_note: *Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, before the stars of the heaven were made, his name was named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits.* 1 Enoch 48:3 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the before-the-foundation-of-the-world naming substance. The framework reads the verse against Matt 16:17's *flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.* The Father's-revelation to Kefa (Peter) reveals what was always true — the Son-of-Adam's name was named-before-the-sun-and-the-signs-were-created, before-the-stars-of-the-heaven-were-made; the gospel-confession at Caesarea Philippi reveals at the earthly-historical-pivot the substance the wisdom-stream had named at the before-creation register. The framework reads this in continuity with Revelation 13:8 / 17:8's *the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world* and *names written in the book of life from the foundation of the world* — the Father's-foreknowledge architecture the cause-and-effect-of-hearing per Red Line #11 operates within.
cards.new_note: *Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 48:3). *Flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven* (Matthew 16:17). What the Father revealed to Kefa (Peter) was old: *before the sun and the signs were created, before the stars of the heaven were made, his name was named.* The revealing did not create a truth; it uncovered one older than the stars. That is why Yahusha (Jesus) credits the Father and not Kefa — the Father is the one who named him in the first place.
cards.live_text: Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.

cards.old_note: *And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, and Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, and hell shall give back that which it owes.* 1 Enoch 51:1 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Sheol-giving-back-the-dead substance — the resurrection-architecture Wisdom of Solomon 16:13's *bringest up again* substance names at the apocryphal-stream-level and 1 Enoch 51:1 articulates at the pseudepigraphal-stream-level. The framework reads the verse against Matt 16:18's *the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.* The gates-of-Sheol do not hold-finally because Sheol shall give-back-that-which-it-has-received at the day-of-Yahuah; the assembly built-on-the-King partakes-of-the-resurrection-substance the wisdom-stream had named the architecture for. The framework reads this in continuity with the broader-resurrection-architecture per the first-resurrection of Revelation 20:4-6 and the gathering-of-the-elect from-the-four-winds at Matt 24:31.
cards.new_note: *And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.* (1 Enoch 51:1). *The gates of hell shall not prevail against it* (Matthew 16:18). The gates of Sheol cannot hold because Sheol has to give back. Enoch saw the earth return what was entrusted to it, Sheol give back what it received, and hell give back what it owes. The assembly built on the rock is built on a resurrection; the gates that could not hold him cannot hold his own.
cards.live_text: And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.

cards.old_note: *And the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.* 1 Enoch 10:8 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the inevitability-of-offences-in-the-present-age substance — the whole earth has-been-corrupted by the watcher-taught substance, and the offences-coming-of-necessity (Matt 18:7's *it must needs be that offences come*) is the architectural-consequence of the corruption-already-running. The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:7's *woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh.* The inevitability does-not-excuse the man-by-whom-the-offence-comes; the architecture-of-the-fallen-age makes the offences-inevitable, and the kingdom-citizen-who-becomes-the-substance-that-causes-the-stumble has joined-himself to the watcher-substance the kingdom-came-to-undo. The framework reads this in continuity with Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 24:5-6's *the earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant. Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth.* The earth's-defiling and the curse's-devouring are the architecture 1 Enoch names the source-of and the King-names the consequence-of at the millstone-warning.
cards.new_note: *And the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.’* (1 Enoch 10:8). *Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come* (Matthew 18:7). Why must they come? Because the whole earth was corrupted through what Azazel taught, and the corruption is still running. Enoch says *to him ascribe all sin.* Offences are inevitable in a corrupted world — and that inevitability excuses no one, which is why the King's woe lands on the man by whom the offence comes. The earth is defiled under its inhabitants, as Isaiah said (Isaiah 24:5–6), and every man who adds to the defiling answers for his part.
cards.live_text: And the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.’

cards.old_note: *Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods.* 1 Enoch 19:1 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the leading-astray (*planao* — the same root the King will use for the *go astray* of the sheep at vv.12-13) substance. The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:7's woe-against-the-man-by-whom-the-offence-comes. The fallen-watchers and their spirits operating-in-many-forms across the present-age are the architectural-substance behind every system-of-stumbling-block the King's-millstone-warning lands-on — the institutional-Christianity's antinomian-doctrine, the Hebrew-Roots false-inclusion gospel, the Pharisaic-traditions-of-the-elders, the Galatian-circumcision-party, the Islamic-transfer (the four-costumes per voice skill framework). The lying-spirits-leading-astray are the architecture under the doctrinal-corruptions; the kingdom-citizen-who-joins-the-corruption joins-the-substance the watchers-loosed. The framework reads this with the patience-not-condescension posture per voice skill — the little-ones-led-astray are victims-not-enemies; the systems-and-the-leadership-who-perpetuate-them are where the woe lands.
cards.new_note: *And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.* (1 Enoch 19:1). *But woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!* (Matthew 18:7). Uriel showed Enoch the angels who joined themselves to women, and said their spirits, taking many forms, *lead them astray* — into sacrificing to demons as gods. Leading astray is the offence. Every system that teaches the little ones to walk contrary to the Father's commandments is doing what those spirits do, in whatever form the age gives it. The little ones led astray are victims; the woe is for the ones doing the leading.
cards.live_text: And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.

cards.old_note: *This accursed valley is for those who are accursed for ever: here shall all the accursed be gathered together who utter with their lips against Yahuah (the Lord) unseemly words and of His glory speak hard things. Here shall they be gathered together, and here shall be their place of judgement.* 1 Enoch 27:2 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the accursed-valley-of-judgment substance — the Watcher-Book passage (1 Enoch 26-27) describing the valley at the centre of the holy mountain (an explicit topographical-pointer to the *gei-Hinnom* (Valley of the sons of Hinnom) on the southern-edge of Yerushalayim (Jerusalem)). The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:9's *gehenna of fire.* The King's gehenna-substance is the Tanakh-and-wisdom-stream's accursed-valley-of-judgment carried-forward; 1 Enoch 27:2 names the wisdom-stream's identification of the place — *those who are accursed for ever* gathered for the judgment-substance at the place-of-judgment. The framework reads the substance as destruction-substance, not eternal-conscious-maintenance — *here shall be their place of judgement* is the place-where-the-judgment-is-executed, in continuity with 1 Enoch 22:11's consummation-of-the-judgment substance and Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 66:24's carcases-and-worm substance. The disciple cuts-off the hand-foot-eye that causes the stumble because the judgment is real.
cards.new_note: *Then Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered and said: ‘This accursed valley is for those who are accursed for ever: Here shall all the accursed be gathered together who utter with their lips against Yahuah (Lord) unseemly words and of His glory speak hard things. Here shall they be gathered together, and here shall be their place of judgement.* (1 Enoch 27:2). *It is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire* (Matthew 18:9). The hell fire the King names is Gehenna — the valley on the south side of Jerusalem. Enoch was shown that valley before the city had a name for it: *this accursed valley is for those who are accursed for ever,* where those who speak hard things against Yahuah (Lord) are gathered for judgment. The place of judgment is a real place, and it is the place where the judgment is carried out; that is why a man cuts off what makes him stumble.
cards.live_text: Then Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered and said: ‘This accursed valley is for those who are accursed for ever: Here shall all the accursed be gathered together who utter with their lips against Yahuah (Lord) unseemly words and of His glory speak hard things. Here shall they be gathered together, and here shall be their place of judgement.

cards.old_note: *But behold lambs were borne by those white sheep, and they began to open their eyes and to see, and to cry to the sheep.* 1 Enoch 90:6 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the lambs-that-open-their-eyes substance — the post-judgment opening of the eyes-of-the-sheep-who-had-been-blinded under the seventy-shepherds-administration. The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:14's *it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.* The Father's-will is for the lambs-that-open-their-eyes — the substance the King's mustard-seed-faith and the disciples' kingdom-witness gathers; the cause-and-effect-of-hearing per Red Line #11 operates in the architecture of the lambs-who-open-the-eyes being-the-substance who-hear-when-the-Shepherd-calls. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture; the kingdom-witness operationalizes it; the gathering is the Father's-will-substance, not the universalist-overriding-determinism.
cards.new_note: *But behold lambs were borne by those white sheep, and they began to open their eyes and to see, and to cry to the sheep.* (1 Enoch 90:6). *It is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish* (Matthew 18:14). Enoch saw lambs born to the white sheep begin to open their eyes and see, and cry to the sheep. The Father's will for the little ones is that they open their eyes. The ones who open them are the ones who could — the lambs who were sheep's lambs. The Father does not lose what is his; what is his hears when he calls.
cards.live_text: But behold lambs were borne by those white sheep, and they began to open their eyes and to see, and to cry to the sheep.

cards.old_note: *And now, know ye that ye are prepared for the day of destruction: Wherefore do not hope to live, ye sinners, but ye shall depart and die; For ye know no ransom; for ye are prepared for the day of the great judgement.* 1 Enoch 98:10 names the Enochic wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the *ye know no ransom* substance — the substance the disciples' *who then can be saved?* at Matt 19:25 presupposes-the-failure-of. The framework reads the verse against the disciples' question. The Enochic-substance names the substance directly: the rich-sinner-substance-presumes-on-the-substance-of-riches-as-ransom; the substance is failed-substance — *ye know no ransom.* The disciples' question at v.25 — *who then can be saved?* — presupposes the inherited-substance that-had-associated-material-prosperity-with-the-Father's-blessing (Bereshit (Genesis) 13:2, 26:12, Devarim (Deuteronomy) 28's covenant-blessings); if-even-the-substance-the-Tanakh-treats-as-blessing is-an-obstacle, who-can-be-saved? The Enochic-substance had named the architecture-of-the-failure-of-the-rich-man's-ransom; the King's-substance at v.26 will-name the substance the Father makes-possible against-the-substance the natural-substance-finds-impossible.
cards.new_note: *And now, know ye that ye are prepared for the day of destruction: wherefore do not hope to live, ye sinners, but ye shall depart and die; for ye know no ransom; for ye are prepared for the day of the great judgement, for the day of tribulation and great shame for your spirits.* (1 Enoch 98:10). *Who then can be saved?* (Matthew 19:25). The disciples asked it because the rich had always looked blessed. Enoch had already answered: *ye know no ransom.* Riches are no ransom on the day of the great judgment; the sinner who trusted them departs and dies. If the thing everyone counted as blessing cannot save, then no one can be saved by what he has — which is the point the King makes in the next verse: with men impossible, with Elohim (God) possible.
cards.live_text: And now, know ye that ye are prepared for the day of destruction: wherefore do not hope to live, ye sinners, but ye shall depart and die; for ye know no ransom; for ye are prepared for the day of the great judgement, for the day of tribulation and great shame for your spirits.

cards.old_note: *And in that place I saw the fountain of righteousness which was inexhaustible: and around it were many fountains of wisdom: and all the thirsty drank of them, and were filled with wisdom, and their dwellings were with the righteous and holy and elect.* 1 Enoch 48:1 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the all-the-thirsty-drank-and-were-filled substance — the broad-proclamation-substance that reaches-the-many. The framework reads the verse against Matt 20:16's *many be called.* The wisdom-stream had named the architecture of the broad-fountain-the-thirsty-drink-from at the prefiguring-register; the gospel-proclamation goes-out broadly because the citizens-of-the-kingdom are scattered-among-the-nations and the proclaimers do-not-know-the-citizens-by-sight. The substance is the broad-substance through-which the citizens-the-Father-has-known emerge — the *thirsty* are the ones whose names-are-written-in-the-Book-of-Life-from-the-foundation-of-the-world and who-hear-the-Shepherd-when-the-Shepherd-calls (John 10:27).
cards.new_note: *And in that place I saw the fountain of righteousness Which was inexhaustible: And around it were many fountains of wisdom: And all the thirsty drank of them, And were filled with wisdom, And their dwellings were with the righteous and holy and elect.* (1 Enoch 48:1). *For many be called, but few chosen* (Matthew 20:16). Enoch saw the fountain: inexhaustible righteousness, many fountains of wisdom around it, and *all the thirsty drank.* The call goes out wide because the thirsty are scattered and no one knows them by sight. But the verse ends with where the drinkers lived — *with the righteous and holy and elect.* Many drink; the ones whose dwelling was already with the elect are the few. The call reveals who was chosen; it does not make the choice.
cards.live_text: And in that place I saw the fountain of righteousness Which was inexhaustible: And around it were many fountains of wisdom: And all the thirsty drank of them, And were filled with wisdom, And their dwellings were with the righteous and holy and elect.

cards.old_note: *This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness, and who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him.* 1 Enoch 46:3 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the named-Son-of-Adam-who-hath-righteousness substance — the Parables-of-Enoch (chs 37-71) had carried the Son-of-Adam architecture centuries before the gospels articulated it at the gospel-pivot. The framework reads the verse against Matt 20:28's framework-major *even as the Son of Adam came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.* The King names himself explicitly as the Son-of-Adam the wisdom-stream had named — the One whom-Yahuah-of-Spirits-hath-chosen, with whom-dwelleth-righteousness. The framework reads this as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR per Red Line #12's Son-of-Adam-restoration — the title-substance carries the Adamic-seed-of-promise the canon names through every Son-of-Adam title-position; the *son of Adam* restoration of the inherited-translation's *son of man* preserves the lineage-weight the title carries. The substance the King is about-to-give is the substance-of-the-Adamic-line-of-promise the Father has-carried through-the-prophets to-the-substance-of-the-substantial-ransom-paid-by-the-Son-of-Adam himself.
cards.new_note: *And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* (1 Enoch 46:3). *The Son of Adam came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many* (Matthew 20:28). The one who gives his life is the one Enoch was told about by title: the Son of Adam who has righteousness, chosen by Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, whose lot has the pre-eminence for ever. The title is not a humble word for *human.* It is the name of the pre-eminent one, and the pre-eminent one came to serve.
cards.live_text: And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.

cards.old_note: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named in the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, and his name before the Head of Days.* 1 Enoch 48:2 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the Son-of-Adam-named-before-the-foundation substance — *yea, before the sun and the signs were created, before the stars of the heaven were made, his name was named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits* (48:3). The framework reads the verse against Matt 20:28's *the Son of Adam came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.* The Son-of-Adam-who-came is the same Son-of-Adam-named-before-the-foundation; the substance-of-the-coming was determined by-the-Father from-before-the-foundation-of-the-world; the substantial-ransom is NOT a defeat-imposed-by-circumstances but the substance the Son-walked-into-knowingly under-the-Father's-determination from-before-the-foundation (per the *must* / *dei* of divine-necessity at Matt 16:21's first passion-prediction). The framework reads this in continuity with Hitgalut (Revelation) 13:8's *the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.*
cards.new_note: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.* (1 Enoch 48:2). *To give his life a ransom for many* (Matthew 20:28). The ransom was not an accident of history. The Son of Adam who gave it was named before the Head of Days, before the sun and the stars; John calls him *the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world* (Revelation 13:8). He walked into the ransom knowing it, because it was settled before there was a world to ransom.

cards.old_note: *And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness, and who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him, and whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (God) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* 1 Enoch 46:3 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the Son-of-Adam-who-hath-righteousness substance — the Parables-of-Enoch identify the Son-of-Adam by name and articulate the architecture the King brings-into-the-Pharisaic-system's-face at the David's-Lord question. The framework reads the verse against Matt 22:42's *what think ye of Messiah (Christ)? whose son is he? They say unto him, The son of David.* The Pharisaic-answer is correct as-far-as-it-goes — the Messiah is the son-of-David per the Davidic-covenant of 2 Samuel 7:12-16 + Isaiah 9:6-7 + Isaiah 11:1 + Jeremiah 23:5-6 + Ezekiel 34:23-24. But 1 Enoch 46:3 names the substance the Pharisaic-answer cannot-account-for — the Son-of-Adam pre-existing-the-Davidic-descent (*whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (God) of Spirits in uprightness for ever*); the Son the King walks-into at the Psalm-110 citation is the Son-of-Adam the wisdom-stream had named the substance the Pharisaic-substance could-only-walk-the-Davidic-half-of. Per Red Line #12's Son-of-Adam architecture, the 1 Enoch 46:3 naming-by-title-of-the-Son-of-Adam stands as the named-figure (NOT the kaph-comparative case of Daniel 7:13 / Revelation 1:13 / Revelation 14:14 the Red Line carves-out separately). FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.
cards.new_note: *And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* (1 Enoch 46:3). *What think ye of Messiah (Christ)? whose son is he? They say unto him, The Son of David* (Matthew 22:42). Right as far as it goes. The Messiah is David's son by the promise to David. But Enoch was shown a Son of Adam whose lot has the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits *for ever* — before David, before Adam's line reached David at all. The Pharisees had the half the Tanakh gave them. The other half was in a book the scribes did not read from.

The framework reads the verse against Matt 22:43's *how then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying ...* The substance David walks at-Psalm-110 — David-the-prophet-in-the-Spirit calling-the-Messianic-substance *my Lord* — is the substance 1 Enoch 48:2 had named at the wisdom-stream-register: the Son-of-Adam was named before the Head of Days before the substance of the Davidic-line existed. The substance the Pharisaic-answer cannot-account-for at vv.42-46 is the substance 1 Enoch 48:2 had named at the heavenly-substance-register: the Son-of-Adam is greater-than-David because the Son-of-Adam was-named before-the-Head-of-Days before-the-Davidic-line-existed. cards.new_note: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.* (1 Enoch 48:2). *How then doth David in spirit call him Adonai (Lord)?* (Matthew 22:43). David calls his own descendant *my Lord* because the descendant is older than the ancestor. Enoch saw the Son of Adam named before the Head of Days — before David's line existed, before any line existed. The Pharisees could not answer the question because they did not have this verse. David, in the Spirit, did.
cards.live_text: And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.

cards.old_note: *Woe to them who pervert the words of uprightness, And transgress the eternal law, And transform themselves into what they were not [into sinners]: They shall be trodden under foot upon the earth.* 1 Enoch 99:2 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the pervert-the-words-of-uprightness-and-transform-themselves-into-sinners substance — the same substance the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) walks-against at Matt 23:15 (the proselyte made-twofold-more-the-child-of-Gehinnom (Gehenna)). The framework reads the verse against the inherited-religious-system-substance that walks-the-substance in-reverse — the leadership-substance claims-to-walk-the-Torah while transgressing-the-eternal-law through the perversion-of-the-words-of-uprightness. cards.new_note: *Woe to them who pervert the words of uprightness, And transgress the eternal law, And transform themselves into what they were not [into sinners]: They shall be trodden under foot upon the earth.* (1 Enoch 99:2). *Ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves* (Matthew 23:15). Enoch's woe is the same woe: on those who pervert the words of uprightness, transgress the eternal law, and *transform themselves into what they were not.* The proselyte is transformed into something — and what he is transformed into is a sinner wearing Torah's name, because the ones who made him teach contrary to the Torah they claim. *He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar* (1 John 2:4). The test is old.

cards.old_note: *And said to him: Go to Noah and tell him in My Name "Hide thyself!" and reveal to him the end that is approaching: that the whole earth will be destroyed, and a deluge is about to come upon the whole earth.* 1 Enoch 10:2 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the proclamation-to-Noach (Noah) substance the King walks at Matt 24:37 — *as the days of Noach (Noah) were, so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.* The framework reads the verse against the substantial-Watcher-rebellion-architecture 1 Enoch 6-9 walks the substantial-Genesis 6:1-4 substance into, the substance the apostle-Yehudah (Jude) quotes at Jude 14-15 and the apostle-Kefa (Peter) walks at 2 Peter 2:5 and 2 Peter 3:3-7. The substantial *as the days of Noach (Noah) were* substance the King names is the substantial-Watcher-rebellion-substance-prefiguring-the-substantial-end-of-the-age architecture — the substantial-corruption-of-the-substantial-flesh-substance the Watchers walked, the substantial-Nephilim (giants) corruption, the substantial-judgment-by-flood the substantial-substance walked into. 1 Enoch 10:2 names the substantial-direct-substance the Father-substance walked the substantial-proclamation-to-Noach (Noah) at the substantial-pre-flood-substance the King's Matt 24:37 substance recapitulates. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.
cards.new_note: *’Go to Noah and tell him in my name “Hide thyself!” and reveal to him the end that is approaching: that the whole earth will be destroyed, and a deluge is about to come upon the whole earth, and will destroy all that is on it.* (1 Enoch 10:2). *But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be* (Matthew 24:37). Enoch tells you what the days of Noah were. A messenger was sent to Noah in Yahuah's (the Lord's) name: hide yourself, the end is approaching, a deluge is coming on the whole earth. The earth was corrupted by the Watchers' works, the judgment was announced to one man, and the flood came on the rest. The coming of the Son of Adam is that pattern again: a corrupted earth, a warning carried by the few, and a day the many do not see coming.

cards.old_note: *And it came to pass after this that I saw another host of wagons, and men riding thereon, and coming on the winds from the east, and from the west to the south.* 1 Enoch 57:1 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the *coming on the winds from the east, and from the west to the south* substance the King walks at Matt 24:27 — *as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.* The framework reads the verse against the substantial-public-visible-second-coming substance the King walks against the substantial-secret-rapture-substance the substantial-modern-dispensational-Christian-eschatology walks. The substantial *coming on the winds from the east, and from the west* substance the wisdom-stream had named at the substantial-Parables-of-Enoch-substance is the substantial-pattern the second-coming-substance walks-into — substantially-public, substantially-visible, substantially-from-the-east-to-the-west. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.
cards.new_note: *And it came to pass after this that I saw another host of wagons, and men riding thereon, and coming on the winds from the east, and from the west to the south.* (1 Enoch 57:1). *For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be* (Matthew 24:27). Nothing secret about it. Enoch saw hosts on wagons coming on the winds from the east and from the west — a coming that fills the sky from one side to the other. The King gives the same picture: lightning, east to west, seen by everyone. Whatever the pulpit sells as a quiet disappearance, the coming of the Son of Adam is a sky-wide event.
cards.live_text: And it came to pass after this that I saw another host of wagons, and men riding thereon, and coming on the winds from the east, and from the west to the south.

cards.old_note: *And the noise of their wagons was heard, and when this turmoil took place the holy ones from heaven remarked it, and the pillars of the earth were moved from their place, and the sound thereof was heard from the one end of heaven to the other.* 1 Enoch 57:2 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the *from one end of heaven to the other* substance the King walks at Matt 24:31 — *and he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.* The framework reads the verse as the substantial-direct-anchor for the substantial *from one end of heaven to the other* substance the King names — the wisdom-stream had named the substantial-architecture-of-the-substantial-cosmic-sound-from-end-to-end at the substantial-Parables-of-Enoch-substance; the King walks the substantial-substance at the substantial-Olivet-discourse-substance. The framework reads this as the substantial-direct-anchor for THE central Red Line #11 four-winds-gathering verse — the substantial-paternal-blood-remnant-of-the-twelve-tribes the prophets walked at Deuteronomy 30:1-4 + Isaiah 11:11-12 + Ezekiel 37:21 + Hosea 1:10-11 + Zechariah 10:8-10. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.
cards.new_note: *And the noise of their wagons was heard, and when this turmoil took place the holy ones from heaven remarked it, and the pillars of the earth were moved from their place, and the sound thereof was heard from the one end of heaven to the other, in one day.* (1 Enoch 57:2). *And they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other* (Matthew 24:31). *From one end of heaven to the other* is Enoch's phrase before it is Matthew's: when the wagons came, the sound was heard *from the one end of heaven to the other, in one day.* The gathering of the elect is loud and whole-sky — the twelve tribes brought back from wherever they were driven (Deuteronomy 30:4; Ezekiel 37:21), with a sound that moves the pillars of the earth.

cards.new_note: *And these measures shall reveal all the secrets of the depths of the earth, And those who have been destroyed by the desert, And those who have been devoured by the beasts, And those who have been devoured by the fish of the sea, That they may return and stay themselves On the day of the Elect One; For none shall be destroyed before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And none can be destroyed.* (1 Enoch 61:5). *They shall gather together his elect from the four winds* (Matthew 24:31). cards.old_note: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, and the strong from their thrones, and shall loosen the reins of the strong, and break the teeth of the sinners.* 1 Enoch 46:4 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Son-of-Adam-vindicated-against-the-kings-and-the-mighty substance. The framework reads the verse against Matt 26:64's answer-at-the-Sanhedrin — the corrupt-high-priesthood-Sanhedrin-aristocracy condemning-the-King at the historical-pivot will-themselves-be-raised-up-from-their-seats and stand-before-the-Son-of-Adam-on-the-throne-of-his-glory at the eschatological-day-of-vindication. The substantial-irony-substance walks-substantively: the Sanhedrin-substance prices-the-King-as-the-blasphemer-deserving-death at v.66 (*he is guilty of death*) and the same Sanhedrin-substance will-themselves-stand-condemned before the Son-of-Adam-they-condemned at the day 1 Enoch 46:4 names the substance for. The categorical-direct-rule-out of any-reading-that-treats-the-Sanhedrin's-verdict-as-the-Father's-verdict — the Father's-verdict on the Son-at-the-Sanhedrin-trial is the substantial-Davidic-Messianic-Son-at-the-right-hand-of-power-substance the King names at v.64; the Sanhedrin's-verdict is the corrupt-leadership-substance the Tanakh-prophetic-substance had walked-out-substantively against centuries before.
cards.new_note: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* (1 Enoch 46:4). *Hereafter shall ye see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven* (Matthew 26:64). He said it to the men who were about to sentence him. Enoch saw what that Son of Adam does to men in seats of power: he raises the kings and the mighty from their seats and breaks the teeth of the sinners. The council that judged him will be raised from its seats by him. The verdict on the night was the Sanhedrin's; the verdict that stands is his.

The framework reads the verse against Matt 26:64's direct-self-identification — the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) standing-bound-before-the-Sanhedrin names-himself-as-the-Son-of-Adam-whose-name-was-named-before-Yahuah-of-Spirits before-the-foundation-of-the-world. The Sanhedrin-substance does-NOT-name-the-Son; the Father-substance names-the-Son before-the-creation-of-the-world.
cards.new_note: *Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 48:3). *Hereafter shall ye see the Son of Adam* (Matthew 26:64). Bound before the council, he names himself with the name Enoch heard named before the sun and the stars were made. The high priest called it blasphemy. But the Sanhedrin did not name the Son; the Father did, before the creation of the world — and the Father's naming is the one that stands when the council's has been forgotten.

cards.new_note: *And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.* (1 Enoch 51:1). *All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth* (Matthew 28:18). He says it as the firstfruits of the resurrection, three days after the earth was handed what it could not keep. Enoch saw the day the earth gives back what was entrusted to it and Sheol gives back what it received. The one who walked out of the tomb is the proof that Sheol gives back; the power he announces is the power of the one the earth could not hold.

The framework reads this in continuity with the post-harvest-sifting per Red Line #11 — the wheat is gathered out of all nations (Ezekiel 37:21) into the wilderness (Ezekiel 20:35), purges-out-the-rebels (Ezekiel 20:38), brought-into-the-bond-of-the-new-covenant (Jeremiah 31:31), and then grafted-into-the-natural-root-of-the-fathers (Romans 11:24). cards.new_note: *And he shall choose the righteous and holy from among them: For the day has drawn nigh that they should be saved.* (1 Enoch 51:2). *All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth* (Matthew 28:18). Power to do what? Enoch says: *he shall choose the righteous and holy from among them.* The gathering is wide and the choosing comes after it — the wheat gathered out of all nations and then sifted, chaff from kernel, goats from sheep (Ezekiel 20:37–38; Matthew 25:32). The one who does the sifting is the one to whom all power was given. The tares were never wheat; the sifting is of the wheat, and he does it himself.

cards.new_note: *And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* (1 Enoch 46:3). *I am: and ye shall see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power* (Mark 14:62). Enoch was told the Son of Adam's lot has *the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* The right hand of power is that pre-eminence. Asked by the council who he was, the King answered with the title the angel gave Enoch — and claimed the seat that goes with it.

cards.new_note: *And again Yahuah (Lord) said to Raphael: ‘Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dûdâêl, and cast him therein.* (1 Enoch 10:4). *When a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils* (Luke 11:22). The strong man has been overcome before. Raphael was sent to bind Azazel hand and foot and cast him into darkness. The stronger one who divides the spoils in Luke is doing in Galilee what Yahuah (God) commanded in the days of Jared, and will do again when the serpent is bound for the length of the reign (Revelation 20:2).
