Luke 17:27's *until the day that Noach (Noah) entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all* names the same two-outcome architecture: the seed preserved through the ark, the rest destroyed. The framework reads the days-of-the-Son-of-Adam as the same separation — the gathered-seed preserved, the corrupt judged.
cards.new_note: *And now instruct him that he may escape and his seed may be preserved for all the generations of the world.’* (1 Enoch 10:3). *Until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all* (Luke 17:27). Two outcomes, no third. Enoch records the instruction: Noah is to escape, and his seed is to be preserved for all the generations of the world — while everything else is destroyed. The days of the Son of Adam end the same way: the seed preserved, the rest swept away. The ark is not a metaphor for safety; it is the line between the two.
cards.live_text: And now instruct him that he may escape and his seed may be preserved for all the generations of the world.’

cards.old_note: *Go to Noah and tell him in My Name "Hide thyself!" and reveal to him the end that is approaching: that the whole earth will be destroyed, and a deluge is about to come upon the whole earth, and will destroy all that is on it* (1 Enoch 10:2). The Hebrew library names the days-of-Noach as the deluge-warning issued against a corrupted earth. Luke 17:26's *as it was in the days of Noach (Noah), so shall it be also in the days of the Son of Adam* draws the comparison the framework reads in the Watcher-rebellion-judgment pattern: the flood came upon an earth corrupted by the Watchers' works, and the day of the Son of Adam comes upon an earth corrupted in the same register.
cards.new_note: *’Go to Noah and tell him in my name “Hide thyself!” and reveal to him the end that is approaching: that the whole earth will be destroyed, and a deluge is about to come upon the whole earth, and will destroy all that is on it.* (1 Enoch 10:2). *And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of Adam* (Luke 17:26). Enoch tells what the days of Noah were: a warning carried to one man in Yahuah's (the Lord's) name — hide yourself, the end is approaching — over an earth corrupted by the Watchers. The flood came on a corrupted earth after a warning most did not hear. The days of the Son of Adam come on an earth corrupted the same way, after a warning carried the same way.
cards.live_text: ’Go to Noah and tell him in my name “Hide thyself!” and reveal to him the end that is approaching: that the whole earth will be destroyed, and a deluge is about to come upon the whole earth, and will destroy all that is on it.

cards.old_note: *Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits.* 1 Enoch 48:3 names the Son of Adam (48:2) as named before the sun, the signs, and the stars were made — the Hebrew library's register for the before-creation existence John 8:58 names: *Before Abraham was, I am.* The wisdom-stream and the parables had already placed the figure's name before the foundation of the world; the Formed one names his own *I am* as reaching back before Avraham (Abraham), the same eternity the parables assign to the named Son of Adam.
cards.new_note: *Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 48:3). *Before Abraham was, I am* (John 8:58). Enoch places the name earlier still: *before the sun and the signs were created, before the stars of the heaven were made, his name was named.* The Yahudim (Jews) picked up stones because they understood him — he was claiming to be older than Avraham (Abraham). He was older than the stars. The Formed one speaks his own name in the first person; Enoch heard it named in the third.
cards.live_text: Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.

cards.old_note: *And beyond that abyss I saw a place which had no firmament of the heaven above, and no firmly founded earth beneath it: there was no water upon it, and no birds, but it was a waste and horrible place.* (1 Enoch 18:12). The bottomless pit the seer sees unlocked (Revelation 9:1) is the waste place at the end of heaven and earth that Enoch was shown — neither firmament above nor earth beneath, the very abyss the fallen star is given the key to open.
cards.new_note: *And beyond that abyss I saw a place which had no firmament of the heaven above, and no firmly founded earth beneath it: there was no water upon it, and no birds, but it was a waste and horrible place.* (1 Enoch 18:12). *I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth: and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit* (Revelation 9:1). Enoch was shown the pit before John was: beyond the abyss, a place with no firmament above and no founded earth beneath, no water, no birds — a waste and horrible place. That is the bottomless pit. The fallen star is handed the key to a place Enoch had already walked to the edge of.
cards.live_text: And beyond that abyss I saw a place which had no firmament of the heaven above, and no firmly founded earth beneath it: there was no water upon it, and no birds, but it was a waste and horrible place.

cards.old_note: 1 Enoch 48:3 — *Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits.* Enoch's own apparatus of names-named-before-creation grounds 108's blotting — the roll is fixed before the world, never added to.
cards.new_note: *Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 48:3). *Their names shall be blotted out of the book of life* (1 Enoch 108:3). Names can be blotted out because they were written first — and Enoch tells when: the Son's own name was named *before the sun and the signs were created, before the stars of the heaven were made.* The roll was written before the world. Chapter 108 takes names off it; nothing in Enoch, or in the canon, ever adds one.
cards.live_text: Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.

cards.old_note: 1 Enoch 6:6 — *And they were in all two hundred; who descended in the days of Jared on the summit of Mount Hermon, and they called it Mount Hermon, because they had sworn and bound themselves by mutual imprecations upon it.* The 1 Enoch apparatus fixes the Watchers' descent to the same generation of Jared that Jubilees 4:15 names.
cards.new_note: *And they were in all two hundred; who descended in the days of Jared on the summit of Mount Hermon, and they called it Mount Hermon, because they had sworn and bound themselves by mutual imprecations upon it.* (1 Enoch 6:6). *In his days the angels of Yahuah (God) descended on the earth, those who are named the Watchers* (Jubilees 4:15). Jubilees dates the descent to Jared's days; 1 Enoch dates it the same way and adds the place and the number — two hundred, on the summit of Hermon, bound by an oath. Two books, one generation, one mountain.
cards.live_text: And they were in all two hundred; who descended in the days of Jared on the summit of Mount Hermon, and they called it Mount Hermon, because they had sworn and bound themselves by mutual imprecations upon it.

cards.old_note: 1 Enoch 13:8 — *And behold a dream came to me, and visions fell down upon me, and I saw visions of chastisement, and a voice came bidding (me) I to tell it to the sons of heaven, and reprimand them.* The vision-and-witness commission of Jubilees 4:23 unfolds in the parallel Enoch apparatus.
cards.new_note: *And behold a dream came to me, and visions fell down upon me, and I saw visions of chastisement, and a voice came bidding (me) I to tell it to the sons of heaven, and reprimand them.* (1 Enoch 13:8). *There he writes down the condemnation and judgment of the world* (Jubilees 4:23). The commission Jubilees describes, 1 Enoch shows from the inside: the dream, the visions of chastisement, and the voice telling Enoch to carry it to the sons of heaven and reprimand them. Jubilees says he became the scribe of judgment; 1 Enoch is the judgment he wrote.
cards.live_text: And behold a dream came to me, and visions fell down upon me, and I saw visions of chastisement, and a voice came bidding (me) I to tell it to the sons of heaven, and reprimand them.

cards.old_note: 1 Enoch 7:3 — *Who consumed all the acquisitions of men. And when men could no longer sustain them, the giants turned against them and devoured mankind.* The mutual devouring of Jubilees 5:2 is the giants' cannibal violence in the live Enoch apparatus.
cards.new_note: *Who consumed all the acquisitions of men. And when men could no longer sustain them, the giants turned against them and devoured mankind.* (1 Enoch 7:3–4). *They began to devour each other* (Jubilees 5:2). Jubilees says all flesh began to devour each other; 1 Enoch says who started it. The giants consumed everything men had, and when men could no longer feed them, the giants turned on mankind and ate them. The devouring of Jubilees 5:2 has a face.
cards.live_text: Who consumed all the acquisitions of men.

cards.old_note: 1 Enoch 10:3 — *And now instruct him that he may escape and his seed may be preserved for all the generations of the world.* The grace Noah found in Jubilees 5:5 is, in the Enoch apparatus, the seed preserved through the Flood.
cards.new_note: *And now instruct him that he may escape and his seed may be preserved for all the generations of the world.’* (1 Enoch 10:3). *But Noah found grace before the eyes of Yahuah (God)* (Jubilees 5:5). What the grace did, 1 Enoch records as an order given to an angel: instruct him so that he escapes and his seed is preserved for every generation of the world. Grace found Noah; the instruction is what grace looked like.
cards.live_text: And now instruct him that he may escape and his seed may be preserved for all the generations of the world.’

cards.old_note: 1 Enoch 10:9 — *Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication... send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle: for length of days shall they not have.* The sword turning the giants against each other in Jubilees 5:9 is this command in the Enoch apparatus.
cards.new_note: *And to Gabriel said Yahuah (Lord): ‘Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication: and destroy [the children of fornication and] the children of the Watchers from amongst men [and cause them to go forth]: send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle: for length of days shall they not have.* (1 Enoch 10:9). *He sent His sword into their midst that each should slay his neighbour* (Jubilees 5:9). The sword has a name in 1 Enoch: Gabriel, sent against the children of the Watchers to *send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle.* Jubilees reports the slaughter; 1 Enoch reports the command that caused it.
cards.live_text: And to Gabriel said Yahuah (Lord): ‘Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication: and destroy [the children of fornication and] the children of the Watchers from amongst men [and cause them to go forth]: send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle: for length of days shall they not have.

cards.old_note: 1 Enoch 10:6 — *And on the day of the great judgement he shall be cast into the fire.* The same appointed day of judgment by fire that Jubilees 9:15 names — the reckoning the bound Watchers of the live Enoch apparatus await.
cards.new_note: *And on the day of the great judgement he shall be cast into the fire.* (1 Enoch 10:6). *Till the day of judgment, on which Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) shall judge them with a sword and with fire* (Jubilees 9:15). The day the sons of Noah bound themselves to by oath is the day the bound Watchers are waiting for. 1 Enoch names it the same way — *the day of the great judgement,* and the fire. One day, two books, the same reckoning.
cards.live_text: And on the day of the great judgement he shall be cast into the fire.

cards.old_note: 1 Enoch 15:8 — *And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling.* The very demons leading Noah's grandsons astray in Jubilees 10:1 are, in the live 1 Enoch apparatus, the disembodied spirits of the dead giants of the Watchers.
cards.new_note: *And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling.* (1 Enoch 15:8). *The unclean demons began to lead astray the children of the sons of Noah* (Jubilees 10:1). Jubilees calls them unclean demons; 1 Enoch tells you what they are. The giants born of spirits and flesh became evil spirits on the earth when their bodies died, and the earth is their dwelling. The demons troubling Noah's grandsons are the dead giants of the Watchers.
cards.live_text: And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling.

cards.old_note: 1 Enoch 19:1 — *And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.* The evil spirits Abram prays to be delivered from in Jubilees 12:17 are the Watcher-spirits of the live 1 Enoch apparatus, who lead mankind astray into demon-worship.
cards.new_note: *And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.* (1 Enoch 19:1). *All the signs of the stars, and the signs of the moon and of the sun are all in the hand of Yahuah (God). Why do I search (them) out?* (Jubilees 12:17). Abram turns from the stars and, in the next verses, prays to be delivered from the evil spirits that rule men's hearts. Uriel showed Enoch those spirits: the Watchers' spirits in many forms, *lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods.* Star-reading was one of the arts they taught. Abram walked away from the art and asked to be kept from its teachers.
cards.live_text: And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.

cards.old_note: 1 Enoch 99:7 — *And they who worship stones, and grave images of gold and silver and wood [and stone] and clay, And those who worship impure spirits and demons, And all kinds of idols not according to knowledge, shall get no manner of help from them.* The spirits set over the nations to lead them astray in Jubilees 15:31 are the impure spirits and demons behind the idols in the live Enoch apparatus.
cards.new_note: *And they who worship stones, and grave images of gold and silver and wood and stone and clay, and those who worship impure spirits and demons, and all kinds of idols not according to knowledge, shall get no manner of help from them.* (1 Enoch 99:7). *Over all has He placed spirits in authority to lead them astray from Him* (Jubilees 15:31). The spirits set over the nations are the spirits behind the idols. 1 Enoch names the worship — stones, images of gold and silver and wood and clay, impure spirits and demons — and the result: *no manner of help from them.* The nations were handed to spirits; Yashar'el (Israel) was kept for Yahuah (God) himself. The idols are not empty; they have tenants.
cards.live_text: And they who worship stones, and grave images of gold and silver and wood and stone and clay, and those who worship impure spirits and demons, and all kinds of idols not according to knowledge, shall get no manner of help from them.

cards.old_note: 1 Enoch 10:13 — *In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.* Jubilees 16:9 says the judgment of Sodom was commanded and engraven on the heavenly tables — the same pre-written doom of the wicked the Watchers apparatus testifies to.
cards.new_note: *In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.* (1 Enoch 10:13). *It was commanded and engraven concerning all his seed, on the heavenly tables, to remove them and root them out* (Jubilees 16:9). The judgment of Sodom was written before it fell. 1 Enoch shows the same pattern for the Watchers: their end was fixed — led off to the abyss of fire, to the torment and the prison, for ever. The sentence is written before the day; the day only executes it.
cards.live_text: In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.

cards.old_note: 1 Enoch 10:2 — *And said to him: 'Go to Noah and tell him in My Name "Hide thyself!" and reveal to him the end that is approaching: that the whole earth will be destroyed, and a deluge is about to come upon the whole earth, and will destroy all that is on it.* The live Enoch apparatus carries the same end-is-coming warning to Noah that Jasher 5:25 reports.
cards.new_note: *’Go to Noah and tell him in my name “Hide thyself!” and reveal to him the end that is approaching: that the whole earth will be destroyed, and a deluge is about to come upon the whole earth, and will destroy all that is on it.* (1 Enoch 10:2). *The end of all flesh is come before me, on account of their evil deeds, and behold I will destroy the earth* (Jasher 5:25). Jasher gives the word to Noah; 1 Enoch gives the messenger. An angel was sent in Yahuah's (the Lord's) name to tell Noah to hide himself, that the end was approaching and a deluge would destroy everything on the earth. Two books carry the same warning to the same man.
cards.live_text: ’Go to Noah and tell him in my name “Hide thyself!” and reveal to him the end that is approaching: that the whole earth will be destroyed, and a deluge is about to come upon the whole earth, and will destroy all that is on it.

cards.old_note: *And again Yahuah (God) said to Raphael: 'Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dûdâêl, and cast him therein.* (1 Enoch 10:4). Here is the binding Kepha (Peter) names — *the angels that sinned... delivered into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment* (2 Peter 2:4). The library tells exactly how: Azâzêl bound hand and foot, *cast into the darkness,* covered with rough rocks. This is the live 1 Enoch Watchers record the apparatus already carries from 1 Peter 3 and Jude 6; the chains of darkness are the chains of this very chapter.
cards.new_note: *And again Yahuah (Lord) said to Raphael: ‘Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dûdâêl, and cast him therein.* (1 Enoch 10:4). *Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment* (2 Peter 2:4). Kefa (Peter) is summarizing something written out in full elsewhere. 1 Enoch gives the order to Raphael: bind Azazel hand and foot, cast him into the darkness, cover him with rough rocks until the judgment. The chains of darkness are these chains; the reserving unto judgment is this reserving. Jude 6 and 1 Peter 3:19 are reading the same book.
cards.live_text: And again Yahuah (Lord) said to Raphael: ‘Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dûdâêl, and cast him therein.

cards.old_note: The 1 Enoch witness names the folly directly, the charge spoken against the Watchers: *Wherefore have ye left the high, holy, and eternal heaven, and lain with women, and defiled yourselves with the daughters of men and taken to yourselves wives, and done like the children of earth, and begotten giants (as your) sons?* (1 Enoch 15:3). *His angels he charged with folly* (Job 4:18) — this is that folly, the watchers who abandoned the holy heaven, the Genesis 6 rebellion the apparatus carries.
cards.new_note: *Wherefore have ye left the high, holy, and eternal heaven, and lain with women, and defiled yourselves with the daughters of men and taken to yourselves wives, and done like the children of earth, and begotten giants (as your) sons?* (1 Enoch 15:3). *His angels he charged with folly* (Job 4:18). What folly? 1 Enoch names it, in the charge spoken to the Watchers' faces: you left the high, holy, eternal heaven, lay with women, defiled yourselves with the daughters of men, and begot giants. Eliphaz knew that angels had been charged with something. Enoch records the charge.
cards.live_text: Wherefore have ye left the high, holy, and eternal heaven, and lain with women, and defiled yourselves with the daughters of men and taken to yourselves wives, and done like the children of earth, and begotten giants (as your) sons?

members.old: The Son of Adam named in the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits — before sun and stars. The Yahusha (Jesus) named at Matt 1:21 IS the figure 1 Enoch 48:2 names by title.
members.new: 1 Enoch 48:2 — *that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* The name given at Matthew 1:21 was named before the Head of Days.

members.old: Chosen and hidden before the creation of the world — the Formed-pre-existent who becomes Immanuel.
members.new: 1 Enoch 48:6 — *chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world.* The Formed one, hidden before creation, revealed as Emmanuel.

members.old: 1 Enoch 46:1 — *I saw One who had a head of days ... and with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man.* The throne-room vision's opening; the Head of Days with the Christ-figure beside Him before the incarnation.
members.new: 1 Enoch 46:1 — *with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man.* The Head of Days and the one beside him; the Son of Adam of Matthew 8:20 is that one.

members.old: 1 Enoch 46:3 — *the Son of Adam who hath righteousness ... whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (God) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* The Christ identified by role — chosen, pre-eminent, revealer of hidden treasures; Matt 8:20 walks the same identification at the King's own self-naming.
members.new: 1 Enoch 46:3 — *This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness … whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* The title by which Yahusha (Jesus) names himself at Matthew 8:20, given to Enoch by the angel.

members.old: 1 Enoch 48:2 — *at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.* The Similitudes name the Son of Adam's pre-existence-and-naming-before-the-Head-of-Days; Matt 9:6's authority-on-earth is the in-flesh exercise of the eternally-pre-existent figure.
members.new: 1 Enoch 48:2 — *that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* The one named before creation is the one with power on earth to forgive sins (Matthew 9:6).

members.old: 1 Enoch 99:5 — *in those days the destitute shall go forth and carry off their children, And they shall abandon them.* The wisdom-stream's apocalyptic-day-of-destruction household-disintegration; Matt 10:35's *I am come to set a man at variance against his father* walks the same household-division-pattern at the kingdom-hearing-of-his-voice register.
members.new: 1 Enoch 99:5 — *they shall abandon their children.* The household comes apart in the day of destruction; Matthew 10:35 says the King's voice divides it too.

members.old: 1 Enoch 100:1 — *the fathers together with their sons shall be smitten, And brothers one with another shall fall in death.* The wisdom-stream's explicit family-betrayal-in-the-day-of-destruction; Matt 10:36's *a man's foes shall be they of his own household* walks the same diagnostic in the present-age kingdom-hearing register.
members.new: 1 Enoch 100:1 — *the fathers together with their sons shall be smitten And brothers one with another shall fall in death.* The seed war inside one house; *a man's foes shall be they of his own household* (Matthew 10:36).

members.old: 1 Enoch 46:1 — *I saw One who had a head of days ... and with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man.* The wisdom-stream's Father-Son architecture at the apocalyptic-register; Matt 11:25-27 names the same architecture operative in the King's own voice.
members.new: 1 Enoch 46:1 — *One who had a head of days … And with Him was another being.* Father and Son seen together before the incarnation; Matthew 11:27 names their knowing of each other.

members.old: 1 Enoch 46:3 — *this is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness ... who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him.* The Red Line #12 title-naming case (kaph-comparative NOT operative); the Son-of-Adam-revealing-mysteries architecture Matt 11:27 names operative.
members.new: 1 Enoch 46:3 — *who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden.* The Son reveals the hidden Father, to whom he will (Matthew 11:27).

members.old: 1 Enoch 48:6 — *for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.* The Red Line #11 names-written-before-the-foundation architecture extended to the Son himself; Matt 11:27's unique-mutual-knowledge between the chosen-and-hidden-Son and the Father.
members.new: 1 Enoch 48:6 — *chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world.* Known to the Father before anyone else existed; *no man knoweth the Son, but the Father* (Matthew 11:27).

members.old: 1 Enoch 48:7 — *the wisdom of Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous.* The revelation-economy aligned with Red Line #11's seed-war-hearing-pattern; Matt 11:25's *hid from the wise and prudent, revealed unto babes* names the same architecture.
members.new: 1 Enoch 48:7 — *the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous.* The babes of Matthew 11:25 are the holy and righteous whose lot he preserved.

members.old: 1 Enoch 49:1 — *for wisdom is poured out like water ... he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness.* The wisdom-stream's direct wisdom-poured-out-on-the-Elect-One architecture; Matt 12:18 names the operative-fact at the Galilean-ministry.
members.new: 1 Enoch 49:1 — *wisdom is poured out like water, And glory faileth not before him.* The Spirit put upon the servant (Matthew 12:18; Isaiah 42:1), seen from heaven's side.

members.old: 1 Enoch 49:3 — *in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might.* The wisdom-stream restatement of Isaiah 11:2's four-spirits-cluster applied to the Elect-One; the same Spirit-anointing Matt 12:18 names operative.
members.new: 1 Enoch 49:3 — *in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might.* Isaiah 11:2's spirits on the Elect One, with the righteous dead added.

members.old: 1 Enoch 10:4 — *bind Azazel hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness ... cover him with darkness.* The wisdom-stream's binding-of-the-watchers-leader-Azazel architecture; the King's exorcisms-and-spoiling at Matt 12:28-29 are the inaugurated-form.
members.new: 1 Enoch 10:4 — *Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness.* The strong man bound (Matthew 12:29) — done in Jared's days, done in Galilee, done again at Revelation 20:2.

members.old: 1 Enoch 54:5 — *these are being prepared for the hosts of Azazel, so that they may take them and cast them into the abyss of complete condemnation.* The wisdom-stream's chains-prepared-and-abyss-of-condemnation architecture; the King at Matt 12:29 walks the inaugurated-action that culminates here.
members.new: 1 Enoch 54:5 — *These are being prepared for the hosts of Azâzêl.* The chains were forged before the King spoke of binding.

members.old: 1 Enoch 10:4 — *Bind Azazel hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness ... and cast him therein.* The binding-of-the-watcher-leader Azazel; Luke 11:22's *a stronger than he ... taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils* walks the inaugurated form of the binding-architecture the wisdom-stream named.
members.new: 1 Enoch 10:4 — *Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness.* The stronger one who overcomes and divides the spoils (Luke 11:22) is doing what Raphael was sent to do.
